split: exact Stage02.2 complete_cycle_mod5_eq2; both IMU withheld, unchanged GNSS mask
decomposition: Reuse cycle-balanced fixed H3 least squares with train-only intercept and affine time trend; subtract ONLY six periodic terms. Residual y-minus-periodic is a sensor observation, not physical truth.
restoration: Fix every slow knot and bias; fit 36 fixed displacement/right-tangent coefficients against forward-model sensor effect minus TRAIN-fitted periodic template at TRAIN native timestamps. Include original GNSS TRAIN PVT on composed trajectory. This is a deterministic projection, not an additional independent sensor likelihood. No free periodic nuisance or joint relaxation.
separation_gate: On complete TRAIN cycles, slow-prediction detrended H1-H3 coefficient norm divided by raw-observation norm must be below 0.2 for the two previously established repeatable channels accel-z and gyro-y, in BOTH A/B. All axes retained and reported. If not, preserve slow results and design the explicit soft phase projection constraint; do not claim physical separation or run unbounded fixes.
synthetic_gate: Before real recovery, exact fixed-slow forward-model synthetic coefficient error <1e-5 in own units; coefficient Jacobian normalized error <1e-5. Variable phase frequency, noncommuting slow rotations, nonzero lever, gravity and bias. Also measure finite-H3 signal-separation approximation and nonperiodic transient preservation, without tuning to them.
restart: One A coefficient-only restart, initialization 0.1 prior sigma times sin(index+1), same fixed slow
metrics: same vector/per-axis/whole-cycle RMSE, GNSS position/velocity; training and held phase projection, sensor-only addback versus physical forward prediction separately; peaks, nonperiodic residual, harmonics and native spectra; independent differences/integration, GP and phase knot limits; coefficient Jacobian SVD conditional on fixed slow (not physical observability)
validity: A/B development-exposed; encoder exogenous allowed; EKF attitude init may indirectly contain held IMU. Main IMU point under rigid mounting hypothesis, not COM or structural-vibration identification. No formal labels, no Stage03.
